reason: As a college student making $18,000 a year, $9.99 a month is way too steep for an app I might abandon like Calm or Headspace. Even the launch promo feels like another subscription trap when I can just vent to free AI tools.
objection: It feels like paying ten bucks a month for a glorified chatbot that I'll stop opening after two weeks.
would_change_my_mind: A solid free tier with a student plan under $3 a month, or proving it's actually deeper and more interactive than standard chatbots.
